summary: Quiet residential kerb with bushland opposite; houses about 13 m away on this side.
reasons: Bush across the road, homes on this side

best_section.where: Carinya Street, west kerb, where the bend runs alongside bush on the east side

drivers.seclusion: Dense bushland on the far side; houses on this side sit about 13 m or more back behind gardens.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a grass verge on the west side; room for a van beside the lane looks adequate but tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street, little traffic.
drivers.convention: Only a few cars parked, near the 100 m end; no overnight parking habit visible.

flags: Creek about 1 m away: flood-prone, though elevation is about 31 m
Dwellings 10-13 m from the kerb at 22 m and 78-83 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy from the east shades the morning; afternoon sun from the west is blocked by houses.
